meaning: Archives the fix for the five REVISE findings (C6, C8, C9, C11, C12) identified by the independent implementation review TASK-20260908-30ce59 against the zero-run preparation snapshotted under TASK-20260907-3928a8. C6 (arithmetic.py point_add's Y3 computation reused the wrong subtrahend for its first product) and C11 (rho.py's EndpointTable.insert_if_absent contained unreachable dead code and could never detect a repeated endpoint, the core mechanism the whole rho experiment depends on) are corrected. C9 (the planted scalar routine existed only as a low-level primitive) is completed with point_add_planted/point_double_planted/scalar_multiply_planted, mirroring the corrected C6 formula. C12 (cgroup admission guard did not check cpu.max and accepted pids.max below 3) now checks both exactly. C8 (scalar_multiply's normalization ownership) is resolved by explicit documentation that normalization is a deliberate caller responsibility. Only driver.py, arithmetic.py, and rho.py changed in content from the TASK-20260907-3928a8 snapshot; independent_checker.py, count_predictor.py, fixture_generator.py, schemas.json, and admission-template.json are byte-for-byte unchanged (verified by hash match against the prior snapshot). This archive corrects a stale self-reported hash for arithmetic.py in implementation-manifest.yaml (the executor's recorded value did not match the actual file bytes at archive time; see implementation-manifest.yaml's coordinator_correction_at_archive_time field for the disclosed correction) -- all ten path_sha256 values above were independently computed by this archiving session via sha256sum against the exact bytes on disk, not copied from any producer-reported value. Independent_checker.py and count_predictor.py remain NOT independently authored from arithmetic.py (disclosed, unchanged, still an outstanding admission requirement). All host/boot/cgroup/image/measurement fields in admission-template.json remain null with an explicit blocking reason, unchanged. This archive authorizes none of the declared 40 scientific jobs; scientific_execution_authorized remains false per DEC-20260907-1ccb1a. A future scientific-execution task still requires: a fresh independent implementation review confirming these five fixes (this archive does not itself constitute that re-review), realized host/cgroup/certificate admission, an exact locked plan, and its own execution authorization.
